title: Safety and alignment in an era of long-horizon models
summary: OpenAI shares lessons from deploying long-running AI models, highlighting new safety risks, observed failures, and improved safeguards through iterative deployment.
body: OpenAI shares lessons from deploying long-running AI models, highlighting new safety risks, observed failures, and improved safeguards through iterative deployment.
summaryZh: OpenAI分享了在部署长周期运行AI模型过程中的经验教训，重点探讨了伴随模型能力增强而出现的新型安全风险、实际观察到的故障模式，以及通过迭代部署不断完善防护机制的具体举措。原始信息显示：OpenAI shares lessons from deploying long-running AI models, highlighting new safety risks, observed failures, and improved safeguards through iterative deployment.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Safety and alignment in an era of long-horizon models”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI分享了部署长周期运行AI模型的安全经验与防护改进，对行业长效对齐具有重要参考价值。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
